steps.code:
# Parse file names and create destination directories
import os

files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path="~/documents/work/meetings_files/", entry_type='files')

# Extract unique file names (without extension) to create directories
file_names = set()
for f in files:
    # f is like "/home/adam/documents/work/meetings_files/2023-apr-03__slides.ppt"
    basename = f.split('/')[-1]
    # split on "__"
    parts = basename.split('__')
    if len(parts) == 2:
        date_part = parts[0]
        rest = parts[1]  # e.g., "slides.ppt"
        # file_name without extension
        file_name = rest.rsplit('.', 1)[0]  # "slides"
        file_names.add(file_name)

print("Unique file names:", file_names)

# Create directories for each file_name
for name in file_names:
    dir_path = f"~/documents/work/meetings_files/{name}"
    print(apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=dir_path, recursive=True))

steps.code:
# Move each file to the new structure: <file_name>/<date>.<extension>
for f in files:
    basename = f.split('/')[-1]
    parts = basename.split('__')
    if len(parts) == 2:
        date_part = parts[0]
        rest = parts[1]  # e.g., "slides.ppt"
        file_name, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
        destination = f"~/documents/work/meetings_files/{file_name}/{date_part}.{ext}"
        print(f"Moving {f} -> {destination}")
        result = apis.file_system.move_file(
            access_token=fs_token,
            source_file_path=f,
            destination_file_path=destination,
            overwrite=False,
            retain_dates=True
        )
        print(result)
